lia: Observed rack21 hosts 110/111 with rising PCIe rx_errors and periodic token tail-latency for multi-tenant workloads since 09:10 UTC. Pattern: tenants with concurrent long-window decodes cause DMA bursts.

omar: Any quick counters?

lia: Snippet: `ethtool -S eth0 | grep rx_errors 
host-110 rx_errors=142 
host-111 rx_errors=88`
`dmesg` -> nvlink crc warnings on host-110 GPUs.

chris: Sounds like fabric saturation from multi-tenant packing. Two mitigations: 1) soft isolation: per-tenant egress and concurrency caps 2) fast migrate high-concurrency sessions to temporary dedicated pool (hot-slice). Soft isolation is low-cost but may increase client latency. Hot-slice costs more but preserves SLOs.

lia: Proposed quick action: apply soft isolation to suspected tenants (id list: 7210, 7211) on host-110 only, monitor 5m, then sweep if good. Command: `curl -X POST $ALLOC/v1/tenants/7210/actions -d '{"action":"set_qos","egress_mbps":40,"max_inflight":2}'`

ops-bot: Alert generated: PCI_FABRIC_HIGH host=host-110 severity=warning count=142 window=10m

omar: If soft isolation reduces throughput too much, fallback to hot-slice: `./infra/provision_hot_slice --tenant=7210 --zone=eu-west-2 --placement=nvlink_pinned`. Estimated delta: +0.5x/hr for 1h. Need PM signoff to auto-bill.

chris: Short-term canary applied on host-110 for tenant 7210. Monitoring rx_errors, nvlink_crc, tail latency.

lia: Canary result after 4m: host-110 rx_errors 142->16, nvlink_crc cleared, tail latency back to baseline. Will sweep host-111 next.

omar: Follow-ups: - RFC to add PCIe/NVLINK signals into allocator heuristic (auto-soft-isolate when threshold exceeded) - Runbook snippet for oncall with commands and rollback steps - Add recommended action to alert UI (throttle vs hot-slice) so non-infra folks know next steps.

chris: I'll file the RFC and add the runbook entry. Runbook rollback: `curl -X POST $ALLOC/v1/tenants/7210/actions -d '{"action":"clear_limits"}'`.

ops-bot: Action log: tenant=7210 action=set_qos scope=host-110 outcome=success
